title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values from a model. In a linear regression model, the sum of these residuals has a special property.

title: OLS Property
text: One of the properties of the Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) method is that it minimizes the sum of squared residuals. This has implications for the sum of the residuals themselves.

text: What is the sum of the residuals in an OLS regression model?
